spans.s:
m. (-शः)
Two shares.
E.
द्वि, and अंश part.

n. (-रं)
A word of two syllables.
E.
द्वि, and अक्षर a syllable.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Measuring two fingers.
n. (-लं)
Two fingers.
E.
द्वि two, अङ्गुलि a finger; if wood is implied, the fem. form is द्व्यङ्गुली.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Measuring, &c. two Añjalis.
n. (-लिः)
Two Añjalis collectively.
E.
द्वि, and अञ्जलि a certain measure, टच् affix; also with the final retained द्व्यञ्जलि.

n. (-कं)
The aggregation of two atoms, the first step in the formation of substances, and when they become perceptible.
E.
द्वि, and अणु an atom, कन् added.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Accompanied, &c. by two others.
n. (-न्यं)
Two others collectively.
E.
द्धि, and अन्य another.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Having two senses, meaning two things.
2 Having two objects.
m. (-र्थः)
Two-fold meaning, double-entendre.
E.
द्वि, and अर्थ sense.

n. (-ष्टं)
Copper.
E.
द्वि two, (metals; gold and silver,) अश to pervade, affix क्त; mixed as alloy with the fine metals; also the य being interchanged with its congener इ, द्विष्ट.

m. (-हः)
Two days.
E.
द्वि two, and अह a day.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Of or belonging to two days.
E.
द्व्यह, and ख aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Comprising two, being two.
m. (-कः)
A sign of the zodiac, Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces.
E.
द्वि, and आत्मन् self, कन् aff.

m. (-णः)
A boy who remains heir to his father though adopted by another.
E.
द्वि, and आमुष्यायण a certain person.

n. (-षं)
Two lives.
E.
द्वि, and आयुस life.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Produced, &c. in two days.
E.
द्व्याह, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Having two between, two off.
E.
द्वि, and एकान्तर an interval, च a line.
